slice: W208: ordinary Dynamic JSON binding and logical Object row bridge

claim.scope: Exact contextual ordinary JSON arm/schema association and borrowed logical BinaryJsonRow/ObjectDocument conversion with shared inherited budgets, within the executed finite profiles; no physical Dynamic JSON arm admission.
claim.adversary_verdict: ROBUST for exact logical identity/schema association and borrowed row conversion within the caller-context preconditions and final executed corpus. Physical capability remains IN_PROGRESS.
claim.overall_goal: IN_PROGRESS: checkpoint B physical handoff, remaining type/layout contracts and MV/projections remain open; performance is deferred.
claim.review_limitation: Luna implementation and review are correlated candidate evidence. Root independently inspected owner graphs, descriptor/copy accounting and literals, executed all guarded workloads and four defect seeds, and checked exact restoration.

implementation.root_cause: A nominal Dynamic type cannot infer its actual JSON descriptor or Object schema. Logical JSON and Object rows have separate immutable path owners but can borrow the same BinaryValue children; their outer site/arm provenance is contextual, not carried by the row.
implementation.architecture: DynamicJsonObjectBinding and BinaryJsonObjectAdapter each have their own source file. Existing Object codecs remain the physical serialization/admission owner. Existing BinaryJsonRow and ObjectDocumentSchema gain borrowed-budget/depth entry points rather than a serializer for each Cartesian type product.

tested_source_identity.encoding: SHA256(JSON.pretty_generate(sorted [path,size,SHA256] rows)+newline) for all src/spec files

invariants: Bind an exact raw Dynamic site key and canonical ordinary arm index; canonical order is not actual-array order.
Full actual descriptor rosters define identity; statistics and actual descriptor ordering do not.
Derive Object schema directly from JSON caps and typed descriptors without a render/reparse round trip.
Validate unused ordinary JSON arms and exact Object plan caps/typed paths too; reject SharedVariant and wrapped or non-JSON arms.
The adapter borrows immutable child BinaryValue owners, preserves typed Nullable NULL and omits only untyped Nothing NULL.
One caller-owned BinaryCodecBudget and inherited depth cover descriptors, values, logical owner/edge work and complete path-copy sets across sibling rows.
Read budget/row corruption rejects as CorruptPartError; existing convenience constructors retain writing defaults.
Bound equal-but-distinct typed runtime descriptor graphs before structural equality; shared declared roots are not repeated for that edge.

literal_checks.qualification: Logical traversal/copy work, not process RSS or unique allocation size. UInt64 scalar payload is borrowed unchanged.

implementation.constructor_guard_tightening: The existing W181 exact counter oracle counted a structurally equal but separate Array(Nullable(UInt8)) runtime descriptor as shared. Two three-node/two-edge graphs require 20 nodes/16 edges rather than 14/12. Root derived both formulas independently; the old exact/one-short fixtures were updated, and a new shared-vs-distinct literal test plus defect seed falsifies omission. No limit was removed to restore a green suite.

boundaries.risk: CAUTION: a logical bridge can discard a typed NULL/schema identity, restart recursive allowance, or silently walk an unbounded equal-but-distinct descriptor.
boundaries.rollback: Revert only the scoped atomic local W208 commit. No push/history rewrite, dependency/runtime change, source-part mutation or physical type admission.
boundaries.caller_obligation: Rows/documents have no outer Dynamic site provenance. The consumer must select the binding by the exact contextual site/canonical arm and call validate_for! against the contextual actual roster before adapter use. W208 exposes this check but adds no physical consumer that enforces it.
nonclaims: Persisted Dynamic(JSON) arm values, physical Object child grid construction, public column/table dispatch or full checkpoint B completion.
Fresh stock native interoperability, complete library parts, ATTACH or CHECK from W208.
SharedVariant JSON, nested JSON persistence or arbitrary JSON/Dynamic/Variant/LowCardinality/Nested layouts.
Complete generic owner/heap accounting, allocator/RSS bounds, full types, MV/projections, repository-wide class decomposition or performance parity.
boundaries.inherited_residuals: W207 Interval/SimpleAggregate sidecar metadata, AggregateFunction(count) metadata outside JSON and broader QBitValue ownership audit remain open.

source_snapshot.qualification: Oct5 shallow archive, not Oct7 latest or the native runtime build source; pinned design reference.

physical_schedule_anchor.finding: Wide mark third words retain physical part P, including Array descendants. Dynamic-site Q and selected JSON-arm R are payload domains; Object child grid is (P,R), not (Q,R).
physical_schedule_anchor.nonclaim: Design anchor only; W208 does not construct or qualify this grid.

guard.execution: Root-only serial workloads; approved escalation preserves guard process inspection/isolation.

reference.native_workloads: None in W208. Logical scalar Object codec reuse is not fresh stock storage interoperability.

affected_roster.hash_encoding: SHA256 of JSON.pretty_generate(ordered_array) followed by newline; resolve base recursively.
